$comment: Live RiskEngine sizing is FIXED_DOLLAR notional + stopLossAssumptionPct risk. ATR/STRUCTURE are research-only until separately OOS/WFO/paper validated. Do not wire a new model into LIVE.

FIXED_DOLLAR.note: Order notional cap from settings.maxTradeSize / defaultMaxTradeSizeDollars.

PERCENT_OF_EQUITY.note: Same RiskEngine path; notional = equity * percentOfEquityPct.

FIXED_RISK.note: Live already uses equity * riskPct / (price * stopLossAssumptionPct). Not a second LIVE path.

ATR.note: Not used by PositionSizing.ts. Comments that say ATR-based live sizing are stale.

STRUCTURE.note: Quant stop/target may persist on trades; OMS still places MARKET orders.
